_about: Inputs for the 'make the public repos private' cost estimate (Option 3). Every value carries its provenance: stated (owner said it), measured (from GitHub run history by the agent on 2026-11-16), estimate (agent's choice, correct it if wrong).

wowza-betting.provenance: measured: sum over completed runs of ceil(updated_at - run_started_at), runs > 6 h excluded
measured: 80 random runs, per-job ceil(completed_at - started_at) / run estimate

linux_rate_usd_per_min.provenance: estimate: GitHub-hosted Linux 2-core list price after the 2026-01-01 price cut, recalled not checked; pre-2026 price was 0.008

linux_rate_usd_per_min_alt.provenance: estimate: pre-2026 list price, used as the high case
